query:
with encounters_in_scope as (
select
e.id as encounter_id,
-- localise once here so downstream presentation reads plain columns
((e.start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) as start_datetime_local,
((e.end_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) as end_datetime_local,
e.patient_id,
e.department_id,
e.clinician_id,
e.patient_billing_type_id,
f.id as facility_id,
f.name as facility
from "reporting"."encounters" e
join "reporting"."locations" l
on l.id = e.location_id
join "reporting"."facilities" f
on f.id = l.facility_id
-- BL-017: facility scope partitioned by the is_sensitive argument
and f.is_sensitive = False
where
-- BL-001: the test patient is already excluded upstream by base__encounters
-- BL-003: open encounters are included only when the
-- includeOpenEncounters flag is 'yes' (the default)
(
e.end_datetime is not null
or coalesce(
:includeOpenEncounters, 'yes') = 'yes'
)
-- BL-002: restrict to encounters whose start_datetime is in range
and ((e.start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and ((e.start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
-- BL-004: optional facility, billing type and clinician filters
and case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else f.id = 
:facilityId
end
and case
when 
:patientBillingTypeId is null then true
else e.patient_billing_type_id = 
:patientBillingTypeId
end
and case
when 
:supervisingClinicianId is null then true
else e.clinician_id = 
:supervisingClinicianId
end
),
invoice_data as (
-- BL-018: aggregate the per-invoice financials (BL-009 to BL-016, resolved
-- in ds__encounter_invoices) to one row per encounter, excluding cancelled
-- invoices. invoice_total is coalesced to 0 so an encounter that has a
-- non-cancelled invoice with no items reads 0 (matching the app), while an
-- encounter with no invoice at all stays null via the outer left join.
select
ei.encounter_id,
to_char(max(ei.invoice_finalised_datetime), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as invoice_finalised_datetime,
string_agg(
ei.products_no_category, ', '
order by ei.invoice_datetime, ei.invoice_id
) filter (where ei.products_no_category is not null) as invoice_products_no_category,
coalesce(sum(ei.invoice_total), 0) as invoice_total,
sum(ei.insurance_coverage) as insurance_coverage,
sum(ei.invoice_discount) as invoice_discount,
sum(ei.patient_payment) as patient_payment
from "reporting"."ds__encounter_invoices" ei
join encounters_in_scope eis
on eis.encounter_id = ei.encounter_id
where ei.status != 'cancelled'
group by ei.encounter_id
),
encounter_financials as (
-- BL-013: patient subtotal, computed once and reused by the patient total
select
encounter_id,
invoice_finalised_datetime,
invoice_products_no_category,
invoice_total,
insurance_coverage,
invoice_discount,
patient_payment,
invoice_total - coalesce(insurance_coverage, 0) - coalesce(invoice_discount, 0) as patient_subtotal
from invoice_data
)
select
p.display_id as "Patient ID",
p.first_name as "First name",
p.last_name as "Last name",
to_char(p.date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
date_part('year', age(eis.start_datetime_local, p.date_of_birth)) as "Age",
p.sex as "Sex",
bt.name as "Billing type",
to_char(eis.start_datetime_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Encounter start date and time",
to_char(eis.end_datetime_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Encounter end date and time",
-- BL-005: length of stay in days (minimum 1) and for in-progress
-- encounters, days since start
case
when eis.end_datetime_local is null then greatest(current_date - eis.start_datetime_local::date, 1)
when eis.end_datetime_local::date - eis.start_datetime_local::date < 1 then 1
else eis.end_datetime_local::date - eis.start_datetime_local::date
end as "Length of stay (days)",
eis.facility as "Facility",
dp.name as "Discharging department",
c.display_name as "Supervising clinician",
invd.invoice_finalised_datetime as "Invoice finalised date and time",
-- BL-019: money columns rounded to 2dp for display, matching the app's
-- formatDisplayPrice (the dataset carries full-precision values)
round(invd.invoice_total, 2) as "Invoice total",
round(invd.insurance_coverage, 2) as "Insurance coverage",
-- BL-013: patient subtotal
round(invd.patient_subtotal, 2) as "Patient subtotal",
round(invd.patient_payment, 2) as "Patient payment",
-- BL-014: patient total (outstanding balance)
round(invd.patient_subtotal - coalesce(invd.patient_payment, 0), 2) as "Patient total",
invd.invoice_products_no_category as "Invoice products with no category"
from encounters_in_scope eis
join "reporting"."patients" p
on p.id = eis.patient_id
left join "reporting"."departments" dp
on dp.id = eis.department_id
left join "reporting"."users" c
on c.id = eis.clinician_id
left join "reporting"."reference_data" bt
on bt.id = eis.patient_billing_type_id
left join encounter_financials invd
on invd.encounter_id = eis.encounter_id
where
case
when 
:departmentId is null then true
else dp.id = 
:departmentId
end
order by eis.start_datetime_local desc
name: Audit - encounter invoice
notes:
Audit report for reviewing invoices against encounters. The date range filters on encounter start date, so each row represents an encounter that started within the range. Use the 'Include in-progress encounters' filter (defaults to Yes) to include non-discharged encounters; included rows appear with an empty encounter end date. Test patients and sensitive facilities are excluded.

Columns included:
- Patient identification (ID, name, date of birth, age, sex, billing type).
- Encounter start and end dates and times with length of stay.
- Facility and discharging department.
- Supervising clinician.
- Invoice finalised date and time.
- Invoice total — sum of price × quantity for all items on non-cancelled invoices.
- Insurance coverage — calculated from insurance plan coverage percentages applied to insurable items on non-cancelled invoices. Uses finalised coverage values where available and falls back to current plan values for in-progress invoices.
- Patient subtotal — invoice total minus insurance coverage minus invoice-level discount.
- Patient payment — net patient payments (payments minus refunds) against non-cancelled invoices.
- Patient total — patient subtotal minus patient payment (outstanding balance).
- Invoice products with no category — items on non-cancelled invoices that have no product category assigned, which typically indicates manually added fees (e.g. encounter fees added outside the product catalogue) or products with a broken category reference.
